# gravitino_statistics Data Source



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gravitino_statistics" "example" {
  metalake      = "example_metalake"
  resource_type = "TABLE"
  resource      = "hive_catalog.example_schema.users"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `metalake` (String) The metalake name.
- `resource` (String) The resource name.
- `resource_type` (String) The metadata object type (METALAKE, CATALOG, SCHEMA, TABLE, VIEW, COLUMN, FILESET, TOPIC, MODEL, FUNCTION, ROLE). Gravitino 1.3.x only implements statistics for TABLE; every other type answers 400. VIEW and FUNCTION require Gravitino 1.3.1 or newer.

### Read-Only

- `statistics` (Attributes List) The statistics for the resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--statistics))

<a id="nestedatt--statistics"></a>
### Nested Schema for `statistics`

Read-Only:

- `audit` (Attributes) Audit information for the statistic. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--statistics--audit))
- `modifiable` (Boolean) Whether the statistic can be written through Gravitino. Only modifiable statistics can be managed by gravitino_statistics.
- `name` (String) The statistic name.
- `reserved` (Boolean) Whether the statistic is reserved (supplied by the underlying catalog).
- `value` (String) The statistic value as a string. Gravitino's value is untyped JSON (statistics.yaml declares `additionalProperties: {}`); a string value contributes its text, a number, boolean, array or object its JSON encoding. Null when the statistic has no value.

<a id="nestedatt--statistics--audit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `statistics.audit`

Read-Only:

- `create_time` (String) The creation time in RFC 3339 format.
- `creator` (String) The principal that created the statistic.
- `last_modified_time` (String) The last modification time in RFC 3339 format.
- `last_modifier` (String) The principal that last modified the statistic.
